# 1 Enoch Chapter 3 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** Look at the trees in winter — they look like they're dying, stripped bare of their leaves. But there are fourteen trees that keep their leaves. They don't shed them; they hold on to the old growth and wait patiently until the new leaves come.

---

*PNEUMA notes: The single-verse chapter is a vivid observation in Enoch's nature series. The fourteen evergreen trees that hold their leaves through winter represent the pattern of faithful waiting that runs through all creation — in deliberate contrast to the unfaithful sinners who will be condemned in ch. 5. The dynamic rendering emphasizes the visual contrast between stripped and evergreen trees.*
